patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,15 +1,36 @@
-class School:
-    def __init__(self):
-        pass
-
-    def add_student(self, name: str, grade: int) -> None:
-        pass
-
-    def roster(self) -> list[str]:
-        pass
-
-    def grade(self, grade_number: int) -> list[str]:
-        pass
-
-    def added(self) -> list[bool]:
-        pass
+class School:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self._roster = {}  # grade -> set of student names
+        self._added_status = []  # track success/failure of each addition
+        self._all_students = set()  # track all students to prevent duplicates
+
+    def add_student(self, name: str, grade: int) -> None:
+        # Check if student already exists in any grade
+        if name in self._all_students:
+            self._added_status.append(False)
+            return
+        
+        # Add student to the grade
+        if grade not in self._roster:
+            self._roster[grade] = set()
+        
+        self._roster[grade].add(name)
+        self._all_students.add(name)
+        self._added_status.append(True)
+
+    def roster(self) -> list[str]:
+        # Return all students sorted by grade, then alphabetically
+        result = []
+        for grade in sorted(self._roster.keys()):
+            students_in_grade = sorted(self._roster[grade])
+            result.extend(students_in_grade)
+        return result
+
+    def grade(self, grade_number: int) -> list[str]:
+        # Return students in specific grade sorted alphabetically
+        if grade_number in self._roster:
+            return sorted(self._roster[grade_number])
+        return []
+
+    def added(self) -> list[bool]:
+        return self._added_status.copy()
